### Highlights

#### 🧪 Pipeline dry run

This is not a release. It exists to prove the build, signing and publish steps
work before a real version depends on them.

- Nothing here is finished. Don't install it expecting a working app.
- Published as a prerelease, so installed clients never see it: the updater
  only ever reads `/releases/latest`, which skips prereleases.
- The assets are real, though. The installer installs, and `SHA256SUMS.sig`
  verifies against the public key compiled into the binary.
